skills.name: animation-vocabulary
skills.description: Names a motion effect from a vague description ('the bouncy thing' -> Pop in). Use when the user asks what an animation is called.

skills.name: audit-technical-debt
skills.description: Audit technical debt, score and rank it, produce a prioritized remediation roadmap. Use when assessing or reducing debt.

skills.name: audit-text-in-ui
skills.description: Audit and rewrite user-visible UI text against the copy standard, routed through MV3 i18n. Use when reviewing screen text.

skills.name: audit-ui-ux-then-redesign
skills.description: Question-first UI/UX audit: reframe feedback into the right design question, critique, produce a redesign brief. Use before a redesign.

skills.name: autonomous-pipeline
skills.description: Run a confirmed spec end-to-end: plan, parallel subagent build lanes, fresh-context verify, ship. Use for multi-task features.

skills.name: caveman
skills.description: Ultra-compressed output mode that keeps technical accuracy. Use when the user asks for terse output or invokes /caveman.

skills.name: ci-cd-and-automation
skills.description: Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines and automation. Use when creating or changing workflows, gates, or release automation.

skills.name: code-review-and-quality
skills.description: Multi-axis code review before merge. Use when reviewing any change - yours, an agent's, or a human's.

skills.name: code-simplification
skills.description: Reduce unnecessary complexity while preserving behavior. Use after implementation when code is harder to read than needed.

skills.name: context-engineering
skills.description: Assemble the right context for a task - files, docs, prior decisions. Use when starting work in an unfamiliar area.

skills.name: continuous-ux-audit-cycle
skills.description: Recurring 7-stage loop auditing the whole UI, planning redesigns, verifying fixes. Use for ongoing design-quality sweeps.

skills.name: debugging-and-error-recovery
skills.description: Reproduce, localize, fix, and guard against bugs. Use when something is broken or behaving unexpectedly.

skills.name: deprecation-and-migration
skills.description: Remove old systems/APIs and migrate users safely. Use when retiring or replacing an implementation.

skills.name: design-svg
skills.description: Design SVG icons in the Nucleus system (24x24, stroke 1.5). Use when creating or redesigning an icon. Not for non-icon artwork.

skills.name: design-system-guardian
skills.description: Audit UI changes against Tihoka's design system - tokens, shared components, hardcoded values. Use before merging UI work.

skills.name: documentation-and-adrs
skills.description: Record decisions and docs - ADRs, architecture notes. Use when making architectural decisions or changing public APIs.

skills.name: doubt-driven-development
skills.description: Fresh-context adversarial review of a non-trivial decision before it stands. Use when correctness matters more than speed.

skills.name: elicitation
skills.description: Turn a vague idea into a reviewed spec - owns the idea-to-spec pipeline end-to-end. Use when the user describes wants loosely.

skills.name: find-animation-opportunities
skills.description: Find places in the UI that should animate but don't; proposes motion, doesn't implement. Use for 'what could animate here?'.

skills.name: find-skills
skills.description: Discover or install agent skills for a capability gap. Use when asking 'is there a skill for X?'.

skills.name: git-workflow-and-versioning
skills.description: Atomic commits, branch hygiene, versioning. Use when committing, branching, or preparing release history.

skills.name: idea-grab
skills.description: Market + internal-gap research cycle that proposes new features and inserts user-picked ones into docs/ideas/product-backlog.md. Use when asked to find/grab feature ideas, run a market scan, or refresh the backlog. Not for picking or building an existing backlog item (→ idea-pick-off).

skills.name: idea-pick-off
skills.description: Pops the top unblocked item from docs/ideas/product-backlog.md and drives it through the stage pipeline (analyze → specify → design → deliver → shipped). `all` mode loops until the backlog is drained. Use when asked to start the next backlog feature, "làm item #N", "làm hết backlog", or continue the roadmap. Not for adding new ideas (→ idea-grab) or fixing bugs (→ debugging-and-error-recovery).

skills.name: idea-refine
skills.description: Sharpen a raw idea through divergent/convergent thinking. Use to stress-test assumptions or expand options before converging.

skills.name: idea-to-interface
skills.description: Turn a UI idea into three concepts and an interactive mockup mapped to the component system. Use before implementing UI.

skills.name: improve-animations
skills.description: Audit motion code and produce prioritized fix plans for other agents. Use for 'improve the animations' roadmaps.

skills.name: incremental-implementation
skills.description: Build in thin verified slices - implement, test, commit, expand. Use for any change touching more than one file.

skills.name: inquiry-creativity
skills.description: Turn a vague topic into sharp questions and verified knowledge. Use to research a domain or generate solutions from first principles.

skills.name: interview-me
skills.description: Draw requirements out of the user via interview or prototype validation. Use when the user can't articulate what they want.

skills.name: learning-and-apply
skills.description: Tihoka's accumulated lessons - grep before coding, distill principles after fixing. Use on every DELIVER/Verify/Review task — inside pipeline-deliver build and on standalone fixes.

skills.name: observability-and-instrumentation
skills.description: Add logging, metrics, tracing, alerting so production behavior is diagnosable. Use when shipping features or debugging prod.

skills.name: performance-optimization
skills.description: Measure-driven optimization across frontend, backend, queries. Use for perf regressions, CWV, or suspected bottlenecks.

skills.name: pipeline-analyze
skills.description: ANALYZE stage of the agentic SDLC — business analysis that produces a confirmed intent doc (needs, journeys, scope, go/no-go decision) or kills the item early. Use for any new feature/backlog item before specification. Absorbs elicitation, interview-me, idea-refine.

skills.name: pipeline-deliver
skills.description: DELIVER stage of the agentic SDLC — plan → build → deterministic gates → verify → ship. Stage contract only; orchestration lives in autonomous-pipeline (engine). Use when active item reaches stage=deliver.

skills.name: pipeline-design
skills.description: DESIGN stage of the agentic SDLC — UI/UX decided and verified BEFORE implementation (design brief + component mapping + mockup + approval/vision gate). Only for items with ui_surface=yes. Absorbs idea-to-interface.

skills.name: pipeline-specify
skills.description: SPECIFY stage of the agentic SDLC — system analysis that converts a confirmed intent doc into a reviewable spec (actor/system boundary, use-case-like requirements, flows/states, function/feature map, traceability). Absorbs spec-driven-development + spec-review-stakeholder.

skills.name: planning-and-task-breakdown
skills.description: Break a spec into ordered, verifiable tasks with priority/parallel/dependency fields. Use when work is too big to start.

skills.name: pre-commit-gate
skills.description: Deterministic local checks before commit - lint, typecheck, tests, build, debt smell. Use before any commit.

skills.name: reprompt
skills.description: Rephrase a failed or fuzzy prompt for a better result. Use when a prompt underperforms.

skills.name: review-animations
skills.description: Review animation code against a high craft bar (Kowalski philosophy). Use when reviewing a motion diff, not auditing a codebase.

skills.name: security-and-hardening
skills.description: OWASP prevention, input validation, least privilege. Use when handling user input, auth, secrets, or security-sensitive code.

skills.name: shipping-and-launch
skills.description: Pre-launch checklist, staged rollout, monitoring, rollback. Use when deploying to production.

skills.name: source-driven-development
skills.description: Verify implementation against official docs/source before coding. Use for unfamiliar APIs or libraries.

skills.name: spec-driven-development
skills.description: Write requirements and acceptance criteria before code. Use when a feature's scope is clear enough to specify.

skills.name: spec-review-stakeholder
skills.description: Adversarial BA/PO/TL review of a spec before implementation. Use to sanity-check a spec.

skills.name: subtitle-player-research
skills.description: Investigate a streaming page to discover how its subtitle list is produced. Use when researching subtitle support for a new site.

skills.name: test-driven-development
skills.description: Failing test first, then implement. Use when implementing logic or fixing a bug.

skills.name: testing-browser-with-profile
skills.description: Brave debug browser for intermittent bugs - one isolated window per agent session.

skills.name: testing-extension-browser
skills.description: Real-Chrome Playwright verification for the Tihoka extension via packed .crx + cloned profile. Use for ad-hoc real-browser verification.

skills.name: testing-with-playwright
skills.description: Playwright E2E for Tihoka - fixtures, shadow-DOM actors, stage2 specs. Use for automated browser tests, not interactive sessions.

skills.name: using-agent-skills
skills.description: Meta-router that picks the right skill for a task. Use at session start or whenever the task changes.

skills.name: vision-reader
skills.description: Delegate screenshot/image reading to a vision subagent. Use when the main model can't see images.

skills.name: visual-reference-design
skills.description: Reconstruct a UI faithfully from an image or verbal reference by decomposing it as a designer before mapping to the design system. Use when user supplies a screenshot/mockup/reference to match. Not for audits without a target or single-icon work.

skills.name: write-skill
skills.description: Create or update agent skills with correct frontmatter and structure. Use when adding or changing a skill.
